name: tvtropes-mcp
description: TVTropes local mirror: polite curl_cffi crawler, SQLite FTS5 + LanceDB storage, 12 FastMCP tools, React dashboard, Calibre cross-reference, cross-MCP bridge for Plex/Calibre.

data_dir.title: Data directory for SQLite DB + cache

tools.name: trope_search
tools.description: Full-text FTS5 search over trope names and descriptions

tools.name: trope_get
tools.description: Full trope page: description, laconic, examples, sub/super/sister/related

tools.name: work_tropes
tools.description: All tropes for a given work (e.g. Series/BreakingBad)

tools.name: trope_examples
tools.description: Examples of a trope filtered by namespace/medium

tools.name: related_tropes
tools.description: Graph traversal: SubTrope, SuperTrope, SisterTrope, Related

tools.name: namespace_list
tools.description: List all namespaces and page counts

tools.name: random_trope
tools.description: Random trope weighted by example count

tools.name: scraper_status
tools.description: Crawl progress, DB size, Ollama backlog

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Vector similarity search via LanceDB + Ollama embeddings

tools.name: trope_lookup_by_title
tools.description: Cross-reference book title against Literature/ namespace

tools.name: calibre_search
tools.description: Search local Calibre library by title or author

tools.name: calibre_status
tools.description: Check if a Calibre library is detected

cross_mcp_bridge.description: Deep-link from other MCP webapps (Plex, Calibre) to TVTropes pages
